name: Methotrexate
one_line: Methotrexate competitively inhibits dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), blocking the reduction of dihydrofolate to tetrahydrofolate and thereby impairing purine and thymidylate synthesis required for DNA replication.

name: Busulfan
one_line: Busulfan is a bifunctional alkylating agent of the alkyl sulfonate type that forms DNA-DNA intrastrand crosslinks, primarily between guanine bases, leading to inhibition of DNA replication and apoptosis.

name: Thioguanine
primary_target: DNA and RNA (via incorporation as 6-thioguanine nucleotides) and phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate amidotransferase
one_line: Thioguanine is a purine analog antimetabolite that is converted intracellularly into 6-thioguanine nucleotides, which inhibit de novo purine synthesis and are incorporated into DNA and RNA to block replication and induce cytotoxicity.

name: 6-Mercaptopurine
primary_target: De novo purine synthesis enzymes (e.g., PPAT, IMPDH) and DNA/RNA
one_line: 6-Mercaptopurine is a purine analog prodrug converted intracellularly into thioguanine nucleotides that incorporate into DNA and RNA and inhibit de novo purine synthesis, primarily used in acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

name: Nitrogen mustard hydrochloride
primary_target: DNA (specifically the N7 position of guanine bases)
one_line: Mechlorethamine hydrochloride (NSC 762) is a bifunctional nitrogen mustard that forms reactive aziridinium intermediates to cross-link DNA strands, inhibiting DNA replication and inducing apoptosis.

name: Allopurinol
one_line: Allopurinol is a structural analog of hypoxanthine that inhibits xanthine oxidase, decreasing uric acid production to prevent gout and tumor lysis syndrome.

name: Dactinomycin
one_line: Dactinomycin (actinomycin D) intercalates between guanine-cytosine base pairs in DNA, blocking the movement of RNA polymerase and thereby inhibiting transcription and RNA synthesis.

name: Chlorambucil
one_line: Chlorambucil is a nitrogen mustard derivative that crosslinks DNA strands by alkylating guanine residues, inhibiting DNA replication and transcription.

name: Thiotepa
one_line: Thiotepa is a polyfunctional ethylenimine alkylating agent that cross-links DNA strands, thereby inhibiting DNA replication and transcription.

name: Melphalan
one_line: A nitrogen mustard derivative that crosslinks DNA strands by alkylating the N7 position of guanine, thereby inhibiting DNA and RNA synthesis.

name: Triethylenemelamine
one_line: Triethylenemelamine is a trifunctional ethylenimine alkylating agent that cross-links DNA strands, thereby inhibiting DNA replication and cell division.

name: Hexamethylmelamine
one_line: Hexamethylmelamine (altretamine) is a synthetic s-triazine derivative that undergoes hepatic N-demethylation to form reactive intermediates that covalently bind to and cross-link DNA and proteins, primarily used in ovarian cancer.

name: Quinacrine
one_line: Quinacrine is an acridine derivative that intercalates into DNA, inhibits the FACT complex to activate p53 while suppressing NF-kappaB, and inhibits phospholipase A2.

name: Aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride
primary_target: Heme biosynthesis pathway (converted to Protoporphyrin IX)
one_line: Acts as a metabolic precursor to the photosensitizer protoporphyrin IX, which accumulates in neoplastic cells and generates cytotoxic reactive oxygen species upon light activation during photodynamic therapy or aids in fluorescence-guided glioma resection.

name: Fluorouracil
one_line: A pyrimidine analog that converts to active metabolites which irreversibly inhibit thymidylate synthase to block DNA synthesis and incorporate into RNA to disrupt processing.

name: Mithramycin
one_line: Mithramycin (plicamycin) is an antineoplastic antibiotic that binds to GC-rich sequences in the minor groove of DNA in the presence of divalent cations, blocking transcription factor (such as Sp1) binding and inhibiting RNA synthesis.

name: Pipobroman
one_line: Pipobroman is a piperazine derivative that acts primarily as a polyfunctional alkylating agent, cross-linking DNA and inhibiting nucleic acid synthesis, historically used in polycythemia vera and essential thrombocythemia.

name: Cyclophosphamide
one_line: Nitrogen mustard prodrug activated by hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes to phosphoramide mustard, which crosslinks DNA strands at the N7 position of guanine to inhibit replication and induce apoptosis.

name: Mitomycin
one_line: Mitomycin C is a bioreductive antitumor antibiotic that undergoes metabolic activation to form DNA interstrand and intrastrand cross-links, inhibiting DNA synthesis.

name: Floxuridine
one_line: Floxuridine is a fluoropyrimidine nucleoside analog that is metabolized into 5-FdUMP, which inhibits thymidylate synthase and disrupts DNA synthesis, primarily used via hepatic arterial infusion for colorectal liver metastases.

name: Hydroxyurea
one_line: Inhibits ribonucleotide reductase by scavenging the tyrosyl free radical on the R2 subunit, thereby blocking the conversion of ribonucleotides to deoxyribonucleotides and halting DNA synthesis in the S-phase.

name: Uracil mustard
one_line: Uracil mustard (uramustine) is a nitrogen mustard derivative fused to a uracil carrier that cross-links DNA strands, inhibiting DNA replication and inducing apoptosis primarily in lymphatic malignancies.

name: Mitotane
primary_target: SOAT1 (Sterol O-acyltransferase 1) and adrenal cortical mitochondria
one_line: Mitotane is an adrenolytic agent used for adrenocortical carcinoma that inhibits SOAT1, leading to toxic lipid accumulation, ER stress, and selective destruction of adrenal cortical cells.

name: Dacarbazine
one_line: Dacarbazine is a triazene prodrug that undergoes metabolic activation in the liver to form a methylating species that alkylates DNA, primarily at the O6 and N7 positions of guanine, leading to DNA strand breaks and apoptosis.

name: 8-Methoxypsoralen
one_line: 8-Methoxypsoralen (methoxsalen) is a photoactive psoralen that intercalates into DNA and forms covalent interstrand crosslinks upon activation by ultraviolet A (UVA) radiation.

name: Vinblastine sulfate
one_line: Binds to beta-tubulin at the vinca domain, inhibiting microtubule polymerization and arresting cells in metaphase.

name: Cytarabine hydrochloride
one_line: A pyrimidine nucleoside analog that is converted intracellularly to ara-CTP, which competes with dCTP to inhibit DNA polymerase and incorporates into DNA to cause chain termination during the S-phase.

name: Thalidomide
one_line: Binds to cereblon, a component of an E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, leading to the degradation of specific transcription factors and exerting immunomodulatory and anti-angiogenic effects.

name: Vincristine sulfate
one_line: Vincristine is a vinca alkaloid that binds to tubulin, inhibiting microtubule polymerization and arresting cells in metaphase.

name: Megestrol acetate
one_line: Megestrol acetate is a synthetic progestin that binds to and activates the progesterone receptor, suppressing gonadotropin release and inhibiting hormone-sensitive tumor growth, while also stimulating appetite in cancer-related cachexia.

name: Procarbazine hydrochloride
one_line: Procarbazine is a methylhydrazine derivative prodrug that is metabolically activated to form free radicals and alkylating intermediates that methylate DNA, primarily at the O6 position of guanine, inhibiting DNA, RNA, and protein synthesis.

name: Lomustine
one_line: Lomustine is a nitrosourea alkylating agent that cross-links DNA and RNA and inhibits protein modification via carbamoylation.

name: Daunorubicin hydrochloride
one_line: Anthracycline antibiotic that intercalates into DNA and inhibits topoisomerase II, thereby preventing DNA replication and transcription.

name: Streptozocin
one_line: Streptozocin is a glucosamine-nitrosourea compound that selectively enters GLUT2-expressing cells (such as pancreatic islet beta cells) and alkylates DNA, causing cross-linking, strand breaks, and inhibition of DNA synthesis.

name: NSC 92859
one_line: I am not confident which specific compound corresponds to NCI NSC number 92859 or its mechanism of action.

name: Azacitidine
one_line: Pyrimidine nucleoside analog that incorporates into DNA and RNA, covalently trapping DNA methyltransferases to induce DNA hypomethylation and direct cytotoxicity.

name: Cladribine
one_line: Cladribine is a purine nucleoside analog resistant to adenosine deaminase that is phosphorylated intracellularly to inhibit DNA synthesis and repair, inducing apoptosis primarily in lymphocytes.

name: NSC 109724
one_line: NSC 109724 is ifosfamide, a prodrug activated by hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes to form cytotoxic metabolites that crosslink DNA strands and inhibit DNA synthesis.

name: Fludarabine base
one_line: Purine analog that inhibits DNA synthesis and repair by interfering with DNA polymerase, ribonucleotide reductase, and DNA primase.

name: NSC 119875
one_line: Cisplatin (NSC 119875) is a platinum coordination complex that forms intrastrand and interstrand DNA crosslinks, thereby inhibiting DNA synthesis and triggering apoptosis.

name: Tretinoin
primary_target: Retinoic acid receptors (RAR-alpha, RAR-beta, RAR-gamma) and PML-RAR-alpha fusion protein
one_line: All-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) binds to nuclear retinoic acid receptors and degrades the oncogenic PML-RAR-alpha fusion protein, inducing terminal differentiation and apoptosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) blasts.

name: Teniposide
one_line: Teniposide stabilizes the DNA-topoisomerase II complex, preventing the religation of cleaved DNA strands and inducing double-strand DNA breaks.

name: Doxorubicin hydrochloride
one_line: An anthracycline antibiotic that intercalates into DNA and inhibits topoisomerase II, thereby preventing DNA replication and inducing apoptosis.

name: Bleomycin
one_line: Bleomycin is a glycopeptide antitumor antibiotic that binds to iron and oxygen to generate free radicals, inducing single- and double-stranded DNA breaks.

name: Paclitaxel
one_line: Binds to beta-tubulin and stabilizes microtubules against depolymerization, thereby arresting cell division in mitosis.

name: NSC 127716
one_line: Decitabine (NSC 127716) is a deoxycytidine nucleoside analog that incorporates into DNA and irreversibly inhibits DNA methyltransferases, leading to DNA hypomethylation and reactivation of silenced tumor suppressor genes.

name: Bendamustine hydrochloride
one_line: Bifunctional mechlorethamine derivative containing a benzimidazole ring that crosslinks DNA strands, leading to double-strand breaks and mitotic catastrophe.

name: Etoposide
one_line: Etoposide forms a ternary complex with DNA and the topoisomerase II enzyme, preventing re-ligation of the DNA strands and thereby inducing double-strand DNA breaks that trigger apoptosis.

name: ICRF-187
one_line: ICRF-187 (dexrazoxane) is a bisdioxopiperazine that catalytically inhibits DNA topoisomerase II and chelates iron, primarily used clinically as a cardioprotectant against anthracycline-induced toxicity.

name: Tamoxifen citrate
one_line: Tamoxifen citrate is a selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) that competitively inhibits estrogen binding to its receptor in breast tissue.

name: NSC 218321
one_line: Pentostatin (NSC 218321) irreversibly inhibits adenosine deaminase, leading to the accumulation of cytotoxic deoxyadenosine nucleotides particularly in lymphocytes.

name: Rapamycin
one_line: Binds to FKBP12 to form a complex that allosterically inhibits the mTORC1 serine/threonine kinase complex, blocking cell growth and proliferation.

name: Carboplatin
one_line: Carboplatin is a platinum-based antineoplastic agent that forms intrastrand and interstrand DNA cross-links, inhibiting DNA replication and transcription.

name: Valrubicin
one_line: Valrubicin is a semisynthetic anthracycline derivative that penetrates into cells and inhibits the incorporation of nucleosides into nucleic acids, arresting the cell cycle in G2 phase by interfering with DNA topoisomerase II.

name: NSC 256439
one_line: Idarubicin (NSC 256439) is an anthracycline antibiotic that intercalates into DNA and inhibits topoisomerase II, disrupting DNA replication and transcription.

name: NSC 256942
one_line: NSC 256942 (epirubicin) is an anthracycline derivative that intercalates into DNA and inhibits topoisomerase II, thereby preventing DNA and RNA synthesis.

name: NSC 266046
one_line: I am not confident which specific drug corresponds to NCI NSC number 266046.

name: Mitoxantrone
one_line: Mitoxantrone is an anthracenedione antineoplastic agent that intercalates into DNA and inhibits topoisomerase II, causing DNA strand breaks and disrupting DNA replication and RNA transcription.

name: NSC 296961
one_line: The specific chemical identity and pharmacological mechanism of NSC 296961 cannot be confidently verified from memory without risking fabrication.

name: Temozolomide
one_line: Temozolomide is an oral imidazotetrazine prodrug that spontaneously hydrolyzes at physiological pH to the active metabolite MTIC, which methylates DNA primarily at the O6 and N7 positions of guanine residues, leading to DNA strand breaks and apoptosis.

name: NSC 369100
one_line: The specific chemical identity and pharmacological mechanism of NSC 369100 cannot be verified with certainty without guessing.

name: NSC 409962
one_line: Carmustine (BCNU, NSC 409962) is a nitrosourea alkylating agent that forms interstrand crosslinks in DNA and RNA, thereby inhibiting DNA replication and transcription.

name: Clofarabine
primary_target: DNA polymerase alpha and ribonucleotide reductase
one_line: Clofarabine is a second-generation purine nucleoside analog that inhibits DNA synthesis and repair by targeting ribonucleotide reductase and DNA polymerases, primarily used to treat pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

name: Vinorelbine tartrate
one_line: Vinorelbine binds to tubulin and inhibits microtubule polymerization, arresting cells in metaphase during mitosis.

name: NSC 609699
one_line: NSC 609699 (topotecan) is a camptothecin derivative that stabilizes the cleavable complex between topoisomerase I and DNA, preventing the religation of single-strand breaks and leading to lethal double-strand DNA damage during replication (primarily used in SCLC, ovarian, and cervical cancers rather than NSCLC).

name: Gemcitabine HCl
one_line: A pyrimidine nucleoside analog that is phosphorylated intracellularly to inhibit ribonucleotide reductase and incorporate into DNA, causing masked chain termination.

name: Docetaxel
one_line: Docetaxel is a taxane that binds to beta-tubulin, stabilizing microtubules and preventing depolymerization, which causes mitotic arrest and apoptosis.

name: SN-38
one_line: SN-38 is the active metabolite of irinotecan that binds and stabilizes the DNA-topoisomerase I cleavage complex, preventing DNA religation and causing lethal double-strand DNA breaks during replication.

name: Bortezomib
one_line: Bortezomib reversibly inhibits the chymotrypsin-like activity of the 26S proteasome in mammalian cells, leading to cell cycle arrest and apoptosis.

name: Nelarabine
one_line: Nelarabine is a purine nucleoside analog prodrug converted to ara-GTP, which incorporates into DNA and inhibits DNA polymerase to induce apoptosis in T-cells.

name: Pemetrexed
primary_target: Thymidylate synthase (TS), dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), and glycinamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase (GARFT)
one_line: Pemetrexed is a multi-targeted antifolate that inhibits folate-dependent enzymes involved in de novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis.

name: Vorinostat
one_line: Vorinostat inhibits class I and class II histone deacetylases, leading to the accumulation of acetylated histones and non-histone proteins, which induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in cancer cells.

name: Estramustine disodium phosphate
one_line: Estramustine phosphate is a conjugate of estradiol and normustine that primarily exerts its antineoplastic effect in prostate cancer by binding to tubulin and microtubule-associated proteins to inhibit microtubule assembly and mitosis, alongside supplementary antigonadotropic activity.

name: NSC 707389
one_line: NSC 707389 (eribulin) is a synthetic halichondrin B analog that inhibits the growth phase of microtubules, leading to G2/M cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.

name: Capecitabine
one_line: Capecitabine is an oral fluoropyrimidine carbamate prodrug that is enzymatically converted into 5-fluorouracil (5-FU), which inhibits thymidylate synthase and disrupts DNA and RNA synthesis.

name: Exemestane
one_line: Exemestane is an irreversible steroidal aromatase inhibitor that blocks the conversion of androgens into estrogens in peripheral tissues, primarily used to treat hormone receptor-positive breast cancer in postmenopausal women.

name: Gefitinib
one_line: Gefitinib is a selective reversible inhibitor of the EGFR tyrosine kinase domain that blocks downstream pro-survival and proliferative signaling in cancer cells.

name: Erlotinib HCl
one_line: Reversibly binds to the intracellular ATP-binding site of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) tyrosine kinase, inhibiting autophosphorylation and downstream proliferative signaling.

name: Fulvestrant
one_line: Fulvestrant is a selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD) that competitively binds to estrogen receptors, inhibiting receptor dimerization and accelerating their proteasomal degradation.

name: Anastrozole
one_line: Nonsteroidal third-generation aromatase inhibitor that blocks the conversion of androgens to estrogens in peripheral tissues, primarily used to treat hormone receptor-positive breast cancer in postmenopausal women.

name: Letrozole
one_line: Letrozole is a non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor that blocks the conversion of androgens into estrogens, thereby reducing estrogen levels in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.

name: Celecoxib
one_line: Selective cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) inhibitor that reduces prostaglandin synthesis, suppressing inflammation and tumor-associated angiogenesis.

name: Zoledronic acid
one_line: A nitrogen-containing bisphosphonate that inhibits farnesyl pyrophosphate synthase in osteoclasts to prevent bone resorption and treat bone metastases in solid tumors including NSCLC.

name: Dasatinib
one_line: Dasatinib is a multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor that potently inhibits BCR-ABL and SRC-family kinases to block leukemia cell proliferation.

name: Everolimus
one_line: Everolimus binds to FKBP12 to form a complex that inhibits the mTORC1 serine/threonine kinase, thereby suppressing cell growth, proliferation, and angiogenesis.

name: Pazopanib hydrochloride
primary_target: VEGFR1, VEGFR2, VEGFR3, PDGFR, and c-Kit
one_line: Pazopanib is a multi-targeted receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor that blocks tumor angiogenesis and cell proliferation by inhibiting VEGFR, PDGFR, and c-Kit signaling.

name: Imatinib
primary_target: BCR-ABL, c-KIT, and PDGFR tyrosine kinases
one_line: Imatinib binds to the ATP-binding site of BCR-ABL, c-KIT, and PDGFR tyrosine kinases, inhibiting substrate phosphorylation and blocking downstream oncogenic signaling.

name: Lapatinib
one_line: Lapatinib is a reversible dual tyrosine kinase inhibitor that binds to the intracellular ATP-binding site of EGFR and HER2, blocking downstream signaling pathways involved in tumor cell proliferation and survival, primarily used in HER2-positive breast cancer.

name: Nilotinib
one_line: Nilotinib is a second-generation tyrosine kinase inhibitor that selectively binds to and inhibits the inactive conformation of the BCR-ABL fusion protein, primarily used to treat Philadelphia chromosome-positive chronic myeloid leukemia (CML).

name: Sorafenib
one_line: Sorafenib is an oral multikinase inhibitor that blocks tumor cell proliferation and angiogenesis by targeting RAF, VEGFR, and PDGFR tyrosine kinases.

name: Lenalidomide
one_line: Lenalidomide is an immunomodulatory drug that binds to cereblon, part of the CRL4-CRBN E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, inducing the ubiquitination and subsequent proteasomal degradation of specific lymphoid transcription factors such as Ikaros (IKZF1) and Aiolos (IKZF3).

name: NSC 747973
one_line: Unknown; I cannot reliably identify the specific compound, molecular target, or mechanism associated with NCI NSC number 747973 without guessing.

name: Raloxifene
one_line: Selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) that acts as an estrogen antagonist in breast tissue and an agonist in bone, used for breast cancer risk reduction and osteoporosis.

name: Abiraterone
one_line: Abiraterone selectively and irreversibly inhibits CYP17A1, blocking androgen biosynthesis in the testes, adrenal glands, and prostate tumor tissue.

name: Sunitinib
one_line: Sunitinib is a multi-targeted receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor that blocks tumor angiogenesis and cell proliferation primarily by inhibiting VEGFRs, PDGFRs, and KIT.

name: Vemurafenib
one_line: Vemurafenib is a selective small-molecule inhibitor of mutated BRAF serine/threonine kinase (particularly BRAF V600E), blocking downstream MAPK/ERK signaling and inhibiting tumor cell proliferation.

name: Romidepsin
one_line: Romidepsin is a bicyclic depsipeptide prodrug whose reduced active form chelates zinc in the catalytic pocket of histone deacetylases, inhibiting their activity and inducing cell cycle arrest and apoptosis (primarily used in T-cell lymphomas; note that Romidepsin is typically associated with NSC 630176).

name: Pralatrexate
one_line: Pralatrexate is a folate analog metabolic inhibitor that competitively inhibits dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) and undergoes polyglutamylation by FPGS, leading to impaired DNA synthesis in peripheral T-cell lymphoma.

name: Vismodegib
one_line: Vismodegib inhibits the Hedgehog signaling pathway by binding to and inhibiting the transmembrane protein Smoothened (SMO), and is primarily used to treat basal cell carcinoma.

name: Crizotinib
primary_target: ALK, ROS1, and c-MET (HGFR) receptor tyrosine kinases
one_line: Crizotinib is an ATP-competitive small-molecule inhibitor of ALK, ROS1, and c-MET receptor tyrosine kinases that blocks oncogenic fusion protein signaling in ALK- or ROS1-rearranged non-small cell lung cancer.

name: Axitinib
one_line: Axitinib is an orally bioavailable small-molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor that selectively inhibits vascular endothelial growth factor receptors (VEGFR-1, -2, and -3), thereby blocking angiogenesis and tumor growth.

name: Vandetanib
one_line: Vandetanib is an oral multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor that blocks VEGFR, EGFR, and RET signaling pathways to inhibit tumor angiogenesis and cell proliferation.

name: NSC 761431
one_line: NSC 761431 (vemurafenib) is a selective inhibitor of mutated BRAF V600E kinase, blocking downstream MAPK signaling.

name: Cabazitaxel
one_line: Cabazitaxel is a semi-synthetic taxane that binds to tubulin to promote microtubule assembly and inhibit disassembly, resulting in mitotic arrest and apoptosis primarily used in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

name: Ruxolitinib
one_line: Selectively inhibits Janus Associated Kinases JAK1 and JAK2, blocking dysregulated cytokine and growth factor signaling via the JAK-STAT pathway.
